description: System design doc: overview, requirements, architecture diagram, components, data flow, tradeoffs, operational considerations.

slots.name: SUBTITLE
slots.description: One-line description of what the system does.

slots.name: META
slots.description: Inline meta spans: author, status, date.

slots.name: OVERVIEW
slots.description:
TL;DR overview: one or more

paragraphs.

slots.name: REQUIREMENTS
slots.description: Functional and non-functional requirements as a list or table.

slots.name: DIAGRAM
slots.description: Inline SVG or ASCII architecture diagram. Sits inside a .diagram box.

slots.name: COMPONENTS
slots.description: Components as an HTML <table>: name, responsibility, tech.

slots.name: DATA_FLOW
slots.description: Data flow: ordered <ol> or paragraphs describing request/event path.

slots.name: TRADEOFFS
slots.description: Design tradeoffs and rejected alternatives, as a table or list.

slots.name: OPERATIONS
slots.description: Operational considerations: scaling, failure modes, monitoring, rollback.
